title: Conditional stability and local editability validation

experiments.name: clean
experiments.purpose: Primary paired learning-rate/batch sweep with update-matched warmup and hold.

experiments.name: corrupted
experiments.purpose: Exactly half the selected training labels are changed to uniformly chosen wrong classes; clean test labels remain fixed.

experiments.name: epoch_warmup
experiments.purpose: Schedule control: 300 epoch warmup (4800 updates at B8, 1200 at B32), same 200-update hold and 20000-update cap.

experiments.name: initial_scale_1
experiments.purpose: Initialization-scale control: ordinary weight scale, same architecture, seeds, labels, rates, and update schedule.

sampling_unit: Independent initialization seed; paired common data and equal-B minibatch stream. Coordinates are not independent replicates.
secondary_metrics: nonlinear relative target error and anchored leakage for 16 fixed random coordinates, both edit signs
inclusion: Retain every attempted run, capped run, failed run, and covariance solver status. Stable/interpolating comparisons explicitly require convergence and a converged covariance solve with ratio<=1+1e-6. Report exclusions.
planned_contrasts: eta .01 vs .002 within B and suite
B32 vs B8 within eta and suite
corrupted vs clean at matched seed/B/eta
epoch_warmup vs clean at matched seed/B/eta
initial_scale_1 vs clean at matched seed/B/eta
statistics: Report all five paired seed effects and descriptive bootstrap intervals; no coordinate-level significance tests.
budget: CPU float64; at most 20000 updates per run. No adaptive hyperparameter search or hidden retries.
interpretation: Necessary conditions for frozen interpolating tangent models, not a guarantee of nonlinear SGD stability or inability to fit corrupted labels.
manuscript_constants: Directional cost uses eta/2, not the 2/eta typo in the local original TeX. Private component bound is squared norm <=2B/eta.
